title: Same model, 24 more points: the harness

scenes.text: Same AI, same exam… and a score 24 points higher.
It happened on WebArena, a test where AI navigates real websites. Same model: from 48 up to 72%.
They didn't change its brain. They changed its harness.
The harness is everything around the model: tools, memory, instructions, and a loop to review and retry.
Think of it like this: the model is the engine. But without wheels, steering or brakes, it won't win any race. The harness is the car.
And it's not a one-off: on another coding test, the same model scores 80% with its vendor's harness, and 59% with a neutral one.
So when you see an AI leaderboard, don't just ask which model it is. Ask: which harness?
Because today, the bottleneck isn't the model. It's the harness.
Save it, and share it with whoever picks the AI at your company.
